description: Complete property purchase simulator. Calculates total acquisition costs (down payment, FGTS, ITBI, notary fees) plus financing costs (installment, total paid, interest) with automatic comparison between SAC, Price, and Consortium modalities. Use to plan a complete property purchase budget.

fgtsCents.description: FGTS balance to use as down payment, in cents. 0 if not using.

modalidade.description: Modality: sac = decreasing installments, price = fixed installments, consorcio = consortium (no interest, admin fee only)

percentualCartorio.description: Estimated notary and registration costs (% of property value). Ex: 1.5 = 1.5%

percentualItbi.description: ITBI tax rate (%). Varies by municipality, typically 2-4%. Ex: 3 = 3%

prazoMeses.description: Loan term in months. Ex: 360 = 30 years

taxaAdminConsorcio.description: Total consortium administration fee over the term (%). Ex: 18 = 18%

taxaJurosAnualBps.description: Annual interest rate in basis points. Ex: 1050 = 10.5% per year

name: calcular_planejamento_compra_imovel
